goal: Test whether aligned D128 trace-block batching can reuse streamed A rings and further reduce the 2^28 Akita root commitment
hypothesis: Two trace blocks share the same A position schedule, so processing them together can halve A-ring reads while the accepted narrow accumulators keep the active destination state near the former one-block wide footprint

evaluator.command: PERF_LOG_T=28 PERF_TRACE=1 /usr/bin/time -l cargo nextest run --release -p jolt-prover-legacy --features akita -E 'test(sha2_chain_akita_perf)' --run-ignored all --no-capture --cargo-quiet

candidate_order: two aligned trace blocks per task
four aligned trace blocks only if batch two clears the screen
